xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4481: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 10): hosted web join page

plan.title: Shared Sessions v0 (slice 10): hosted web join page
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: A person without Overdeck installed cannot join a shared conversation: the /s/:code page only finds a local dashboard, the account Worker has no browser sign-in (no CORS, only loopback/native redirects and device flow), and the share Worker's viewer socket needs a bearer header a browser WebSocket cannot send.
narratives.Proposal: Add a third PKCE redirect rule (share callback, platform web) and two AccountRpc methods (redeemWebCode, signOutDevice) to the account Worker. Make the share Worker the OAuth client: it runs /auth/signin and /auth/callback, keeps the device token in an AES-GCM sealed HttpOnly cookie, exposes /v1/web/session and a cookie+Origin authenticated /v1/rooms/:code/web-join socket that reaches the unchanged ShareRoom join path, and answers ping with pong. Serve a small esbuild-built plain-DOM viewer (reusing slice 4's WebRtcViewer) from the Worker's static assets on the /s/:code page, next to the existing localhost probe. Full design in .pan/drafts/PAN-4481.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No identity-only participant grant or allowlist change (OD-2 stands)
- No server-rendered conversation view; no content passes through the share Worker
- No composer, drafts or contributor input in the browser viewer (slice 5, PAN-4476)
- No terminal channel in the browser viewer (slice 6, PAN-4477)
- No markdown, tool-call, thinking or work-log rendering in the browser viewer
- No CORS headers on the account Worker and no browser call to account.overdeck.ai /oauth/* or /v1/*
- No change to ShareRoom room rules, viewer protocol frames, the host PeerHub or /api/shares
- No change to /v1/rooms/:code/join (stays bearer-only)
- No deploy, wrangler login or wrangler secret put by any agent
- No pan join / CLI changes (slice 9, PAN-4480)

metadata.sizeJustification: One user-visible feature split across two Workers: the account half (redirect rule + RPC) has no user value alone and defines the contract the share half consumes, and the viewer bundle is useless without the cookie-authenticated socket. Most of the ~37 files are new small modules, their tests and four docs; items are fine-grained with explicit edges so independent parts (account, DO ping, build pipeline, join-socket) run in parallel.

autoDecisions.summary: The share Worker is the OAuth client and redeems the code over the ACCOUNT service binding (AccountRpc.redeemWebCode).
autoDecisions.rationale: The account Worker sends no CORS headers by design, so the page cannot call /oauth/token; the binding avoids a public hop between Workers (PAN-658 security section) and keeps the token server-side (D-R3-2).

autoDecisions.summary: The browser's device token lives only in an AES-GCM sealed HttpOnly SameSite=Strict __Host- cookie keyed by a new WEB_SESSION_KEY secret.
autoDecisions.rationale: Page JavaScript never holds a credential, a stolen cookie is useless outside the share Worker, and the Worker can trust the cookie contents without a database.

autoDecisions.summary: The web flow reuses the PKCE purpose with a third, separate redirect rule (validateShareRedirect) and a new platform value 'web'; no D1 migration.
autoDecisions.rationale: auth_requests.purpose and pending_attempts.last_flow have CHECK constraints that a new purpose would need a table rebuild to change; devices.platform has no CHECK. The operator asked to keep redirect rules as separate functions (PAN-4831 coordination).

autoDecisions.summary: The browser uses a separate socket path /v1/rooms/:code/web-join authenticated by cookie plus an exact Origin check; /join stays bearer-only.
autoDecisions.rationale: Browser WebSockets cannot send Authorization headers; a separate path keeps the server path's contract unchanged and adds cross-site WebSocket hijacking defence.

autoDecisions.summary: OD-2 stands: browser viewers must be allowlisted overdeck.ai accounts; a non-allowlisted user sees an invite-only page.
autoDecisions.rationale: The approved scope lists three deliverables and none changes the allowlist; an identity-only participant grant is a separate PAN-4293 decision.

autoDecisions.summary: The hosted viewer is plain TypeScript and DOM (no React, no markdown) bundled by esbuild 0.28.1 into the Worker's static assets, reusing WebRtcViewer through a contracts shim.
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest bundle with no new runtime dependencies; esbuild 0.28.1 is the version wrangler 4.146.0 already resolves; the shim keeps effect out of the bundle; plain-text rendering removes an XSS surface.

autoDecisions.summary: Join intent stays an explicit click; a per-tab sessionStorage marker lets a reload rejoin without a click.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4475 D-1: opening the socket reveals identity to the host, so no URL may trigger it; sessionStorage cannot be set by a link.

autoDecisions.summary: The browser viewer is read-only in this slice; the composer arrives with slice 5 (PAN-4476).
autoDecisions.rationale: The slice 4 dashboard viewer is also read-only today, and drafts/direct-submit are slice 5's scope.

autoDecisions.summary: The localhost probe stays and still navigates to an installed dashboard, unless the visitor already started a browser join.
autoDecisions.rationale: An installed dashboard is the richer client and the PAN-4475 behaviour must not regress.

autoDecisions.summary: The plan stays one issue with a sizeJustification instead of splitting the account half into a sibling issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: The account changes alone deliver no user-visible value and define the RPC contract the share half consumes; the operator approved the three parts together.

items.title: Account Worker: accept the share callback as a third PKCE redirect rule paired with platform web

expected_outputs: pkce.test.ts and device-flow.test.ts pass, including the new share-redirect cases

narrative.Action: Implement PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4481.md WI-1. Add SHARE_BASE_URL (optional, committed var https://share.overdeck.ai) to services/account env.ts Config as shareBaseUrl. In pkce.ts add shareRedirectUri(config) and validateShareRedirect(raw, config) as separate functions beside validateLoopbackRedirect and NATIVE_APP_REDIRECT; validateClientRedirect(raw, config) tries native, then share, then loopback. parseStart/readPayload take config. Pairing rule: the share redirect requires platform=web and platform=web requires the share redirect. devices.ts PLATFORM_RE gains |web and defaultLabel('web') returns 'Web browser'. device-flow.ts issueCode refuses platform=web with 400 invalid_request. Extend pkce.test.ts and device-flow.test.ts as the PRD lists.

items.title: Given SHARE_BASE_URL=https://share.test, GET /auth/start with redirect_uri=https://share.test/auth/callback and platform=web returns 302 to GitHub, and after the GitHub leg the minted device row has platform 'web' and label 'Web browser'
GET /auth/start rejects with the 400 page each of https://share.test/auth/callback/x, https://share.test/auth/callback?x=1, http://share.test/auth/callback and https://evil.test/auth/callback
GET /auth/start rejects with the 400 page the share redirect with platform=linux-x64, a loopback redirect with platform=web, and the share redirect when SHARE_BASE_URL is unset
POST /oauth/device/code with platform=web returns 400 invalid_request, and GET /auth/start still accepts the existing loopback and ai.overdeck.app:/oauth/callback redirects
Account Worker: AccountRpc.redeemWebCode and AccountRpc.signOutDevice

expected_outputs: web-rpc.test.ts passes and the existing /oauth/token tests in pkce.test.ts pass unchanged

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-2. Split pkce.ts exchangeAuthorizationCode into redeemAuthorizationCode (returns RedeemResult) plus the unchanged HTTP wrapper; add redeemWebCode(rc, input) that refuses any redirectUri other than the share redirect with invalid_request. Add signOutDeviceToken(rc, token) in devices.ts (revokes with revoked_by 'user'; an expired grant still signs out). Export RedeemWebCodeInput, RedeemResult and SignOutResult types from contract.ts. Add the two methods to class AccountRpc in index.ts using rpcContext. New tests/unit/services/account/web-rpc.test.ts on the D1 shim with an injected clock.

items.title: redeemWebCode with a valid share-redirect code and verifier returns ok with an accessToken matching ^odd_[0-9a-f]{64}$ for a device whose platform is web

redeemWebCode returns invalid_grant for a reused code, a wrong verifier and a code older than 5 minutes, returns access_denied when the grant was revoked before redeem, and returns invalid_request for a loopback redirectUri
signOutDeviceToken makes verifyDeviceToken return device_revoked for that token and returns invalid_token for an unknown token
POST /oauth/token returns the same status and JSON body as before for every existing authorization_code test case

In services/share/src/room.ts RoomHost constructor call ctx.setWebSocketAutoResponse(new WebSocketRequestResponsePair('ping', 'pong')) before blockConcurrencyWhile, with the comment from the PRD. Share Worker: browser sign-in, sealed session cookie and GET /v1/web/session

expected_outputs: web-auth.test.ts passes and the existing routes.test.ts cases still pass

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-4. env.ts: ACCOUNT_BASE_URL, WEB_SESSION_KEY (64 hex), ASSETS?: Fetcher, parseWebConfig/missingWebConfig, Config.web. account.ts: structural redeemWebCode/signOutDevice on AccountBinding and verifyDeviceIdentity(env, token) split out of verifyIdentity. New src/web-auth.ts: AES-GCM seal/unseal, cookie constants and attributes per PRD D-6, readWebSession, and handlers GET /auth/signin, GET /auth/callback, POST /auth/signout (Origin check), GET /v1/web/session with the exact outcomes and page texts in the PRD. pages.ts exports messagePage(title, bodyHtml, status) built on page() with HTML_CSP. routes.ts adds the four rows and the healthz web flag. New tests/unit/services/share/web-auth.test.ts drives routes.handle() with injected deps and a fake ACCOUNT.

items.title: GET /auth/signin?code=<CODE> sets __Host-ods_signin (HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=600) and returns 302 to <ACCOUNT_BASE_URL>/auth/start with platform=web, code_challenge_method=S256 and redirect_uri=<PUBLIC_BASE_URL>/auth/callback

GET /auth/callback with the matching state calls ACCOUNT.redeemWebCode with the sealed verifier, sets __Host-ods_session with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/ and Max-Age=2592000, and returns 303 to /s/<CODE>; the cookie value does not contain the odd_ token in plaintext
GET /auth/callback returns the documented page for a mismatched state, a sign-in cookie older than 600 s, invite_only, github_denied, a redeem access_denied and a throwing redeemWebCode

GET /v1/web/session returns signedIn true with githubId, login and avatarUrl for a valid session, signedIn false with reason grant_expired for an expired grant, and signedIn false plus a cleared cookie for a revoked device

Without WEB_SESSION_KEY every web route returns 503 not_configured and GET /healthz returns "web": false; POST /auth/signout with a foreign Origin returns 403 forbidden_origin and does not call signOutDevice
Share Worker: GET /v1/rooms/:code/web-join authenticated by session cookie and Origin

expected_outputs: routes.test.ts and miniflare.test.ts pass including the web-join cases

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-5 using the webJoinSocket handler shown there (upgradeRefusal, web config gate, Origin === PUBLIC_BASE_URL, readWebSession, verifyDeviceIdentity, forwardUpgrade to INTERNAL.join with X-Share-Identity). Add the unit cases to tests/unit/services/share/routes.test.ts. In tests/integration/services/share/miniflare.test.ts bind ACCOUNT_BASE_URL and WEB_SESSION_KEY, extend the inline AccountRpc stub with redeemWebCode and signOutDevice, and run sign-in -> callback -> web-join -> status lobby plus the foreign-Origin refusal.

items.title: Given a valid session cookie and Origin equal to PUBLIC_BASE_URL, GET /v1/rooms/<CODE>/web-join?v=1 forwards the upgrade to the room's /join with X-Share-Identity of the verified identity

web-join returns 403 forbidden_origin for a missing or foreign Origin, 401 invalid_token without a cookie, with a tampered cookie, or with only an Authorization bearer header, 403 grant_expired, and 404 for an unknown room
In Miniflare, sign-in then callback then a web-join socket with the session cookie receives status lobby and the host snapshot lists the viewer

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-6. Add esbuild 0.28.1 (exact) as a devDependency of services/share and a build:web script; run bun install so bun.lock updates. New scripts/build-web.mjs bundles web/main.ts to public/viewer/viewer.js (iife, minify, es2022, alias @overdeck/contracts -> web/contracts.ts). New web/contracts.ts shim re-exporting packages/contracts/src/sharing.ts and sharing-wire.ts, web/tsconfig.json (DOM libs, paths alias to the shim), and a web/main.ts stub importing WebRtcViewer by relative path. wrangler.jsonc: assets {directory ./public, binding ASSETS, run_worker_first true}, build.command, ACCOUNT_BASE_URL var, WEB_SESSION_KEY secret comment. .gitignore public/viewer/; commit public/.gitkeep. Root package.json typecheck:share runs both tsconfigs. Resolve the two implementation checkpoints in the PRD (tsc through the shim; dry-run running build.command) using their stated fallbacks.

Hosted viewer: BrowserJoin state machine for the web-join socket

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-7: services/share/web/join-socket.ts with the BrowserJoin class, deps, constants and rules exactly as specified (status and close-code mapping mirroring src/dashboard/server/services/share-join.ts, ping every 30 s with a 75 s pong timeout, ICE request/cache/timeout, restart dance, one-shot 10 s offer watchdog, pre-open failure callback). No DOM access. Tests in tests/unit/services/share/web/join-socket.test.ts with a fake WebSocket class and vi.useFakeTimers() only.

items.title: Each service status frame and each close code 1000, 4003, 4004, 4008, 4009, 4010, 4011 and 4013 produces the BrowserJoinState listed in the PRD, and a signal frame received in lobby is dropped
With fake timers, the socket sends the text ping at 30 s, and closes and reports disconnected with error connection_lost when 75 s pass without a pong
status admitted sends one ice-servers request; fetchIceServers resolves the cached list, resolves [] on error turn_unavailable, and resolves [] after 5 s without an answer
reconnect() sends no leave frame and opens the second socket only after the first socket's close event, or after 5 s when no close event arrives

When no offer arrives 10 s after status admitted, BrowserJoin closes and reopens the socket once and not a second time; an error before open calls onPreOpenFailure and reports disconnected with error unreachable

Share Worker: hosted-join section and CSP on /s/:code, probe guard, and /viewer/viewer.js route

expected_outputs: routes.test.ts passes including the hosted-page and asset-route cases

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-9. pages.ts invitePage(shortCode, nonce, web) renders today's page unchanged when web is null; with web it adds data-short-code on body, wraps the existing content in section#local-join, adds section#web-join (hidden), the deferred /viewer/viewer.js script and the CSP from the PRD. The probe script only navigates when document.documentElement.dataset.hostedJoin !== 'started'. Viewer CSS goes into STYLE. routes.ts passes the web flag to invitePage and adds GET /viewer/viewer.js served through env.ASSETS with Content-Type text/javascript. The hosted page and messagePage send Referrer-Policy same-origin (page() gains a referrerPolicy parameter defaulting to no-referrer) so the Sign out form POST carries a real Origin. The ws origin in the CSP and in main.ts follows the page scheme (wss for https, ws for local http). Extend tests/unit/services/share/routes.test.ts.

items.title: With web configured, GET /s/<active code> renders data-short-code="<CODE>", section id="web-join" and <script src="/viewer/viewer.js" defer>, with the CSP default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'nonce-<nonce>'; connect-src 'self' wss://<share host> http://localhost:3011 http://127.0.0.1:3011; img-src https://avatars.githubusercontent.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'self', and sends Referrer-Policy same-origin
Without web config, GET /s/<active code> returns the same CSP and Referrer-Policy no-referrer as before this change, and the ended page contains no script in both modes
The probe script calls location.assign only when document.documentElement.dataset.hostedJoin is not started
GET /viewer/viewer.js returns 200 text/javascript with X-Content-Type-Options nosniff when the ASSETS binding returns the file, and 404 not_found when ASSETS is absent
